title: How to plan an essay
body: Work through each step in order. The progress bar fills as you go.
instruction: Move through the steps with the Back and Next buttons.

_steps.label: Intro
_steps.body: Here is what this short guide covers and why it helps you plan before you write.

_steps.label: Explore
_steps.body: Look at a worked example so you can see the shape of a plan before you build your own.

_steps.label: Practise
_steps.body: Sketch a quick plan for your own question. Three or four points is plenty to start.

_steps.label: Review
_steps.body: Check your plan answers the question and that each point earns its place. You are ready to write.
